tex_content.html:
When $\mathcal C$ lies in a time-slice of a Ricci flow, the second inequality in Condition (8) is equivalent to \[ \sup _{\mathcal C}\frac{|\partial _tR|}{R^2}<C. \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Use $\partial _tR=\triangle R+2|\Ric |^2$.

copy_context.description:
\label{partialtR}

When $\mathcal C$ lies in a time-slice of a Ricci flow, the second
inequality in Condition~(8) is equivalent to
\[
 \sup_{\mathcal C}\frac{|\partial_tR|}{R^2}<C.
\]
\end{claim}
